sloka: शृणु राजन्पुरावृत्तं तदा देवासुरे युधि ।दैत्याः सुरैर्भर्त्स्यमाना भृगुपत्नीं समाश्रिताः ।। ७.५१.११ ॥
transliteration: śṛṇu rājanpurāvṛttaṁ tadā devāsure yudhi ।daityāḥ surairbhartsyamānā bhṛgupatnīṁ samāśritāḥ ।। 7.51.11 ॥

translations.english: Durvasa instructs the king to listen to an ancient event from the time of the war between gods and asuras, when the demons, being oppressed by the gods, sought refuge with Bhrigu's wife.
